diagnostics.message: `google_tags_tag_binding.binding` resolves `tag_value` via a static context lookup (`lookup(local.ctx.tag_values, each.value, each.value)`) with no data reference to the tag values managed by this module. The Tag Bindings API requires the TagValue to already exist (`tagValues/{id}` or namespaced format), so when the referenced values are created in this same module (e.g. with `tags_config.force_context_ids` making their ids predictable for `var.tag_bindings`), the binding can be created before the value exists and fail at apply time. It needs to wait for `google_tags_tag_value.default` to be created first; since values may also be externally managed, a bare `depends_on = [google_tags_tag_value.default]` is the idiomatic fix.
